description: This Java source file defines an abstract actor class for the Akka framework, providing functionality to lock and unlock message handling, with support for time-based locking via scheduler.

classes.name: AbstractActorWithLock
classes.description: An abstract actor class that supports locking its message handling for a specified duration, preventing message processing during the lock period.

methods.name: AbstractActorWithLock
methods.description: Constructor initializing the lock state and timeout.

methods.name: handleMessage
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses for handling messages in the usual state.

methods.name: setLocked
methods.description: Locks the actor for a specified maximum duration, scheduling an unlock after the given time.

methods.name: unlock
methods.description: Triggers the actor to unlock and process messages again.

methods.name: become
methods.description: Switches the actor's message handling behavior to a new receive handler, with the ability to lock behavior.

methods.name: become
methods.description: Overloaded method to switch message handling behavior with option to discard old handler.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Initial message handler combining lock behavior with the subclass's handleMessage.

methods.name: postStop
methods.description: Cleans up resources, like canceling the lock timeout when the actor stops.
